SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_rl,
       sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_lines, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
       count(DISTINCT f.channel_code) AS chans
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE cs.store_id = 107 AND cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY ALL
